verdict.rationale: Stable ships automation features such as keyword-based auto-routing, AI sorting, and API/webhook workflows, so asking whether those automations can be versioned and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no capability to version, review the change history of, or roll back automation rules. The only related item is mail audit logs, which track mail rather than automation configuration, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
